$comment: DEMONSTRATION IDEA LIBRARY — illustrative research questions, synthetic. Not attributed to any real researcher or institution.

ideas.title: Does automation raise productivity without raising wages?
ideas.description: Investigate whether productivity gains from automation are captured by capital rather than passed through to workers, and under what institutional conditions pass-through occurs.

ideas.title: Do low-skilled workers bear the brunt of automation?
ideas.description: Test whether displacement is concentrated in routine task-intensive occupations or diffuses across skill levels.

ideas.title: How does AI adoption affect youth employment?
ideas.description: Examine entry-level labour markets where automation substitutes for tasks historically performed by new entrants.

ideas.title: Does AI widen wage inequality within firms?
ideas.description: Study firm-level wage dispersion as AI tools complement high-skill tasks and substitute for others.

ideas.title: Do labour effects of AI differ between developed and developing economies?
ideas.description: Compare exposure to automation across economies with different factor endowments and informal sectors.

ideas.title: Does carbon pricing reduce emissions without regressive effects?
ideas.description: Evaluate emissions outcomes against distributional consequences, including the role of revenue recycling.

ideas.title: Does economic interdependence restrain or enable coercion?
ideas.description: Test competing liberal and realist expectations about how trade ties condition coercive statecraft.

ideas.title: When does strategic hedging collapse into alignment?
ideas.description: Identify the thresholds at which middle powers abandon hedging for formal alignment.

ideas.title: Do security-dilemma dynamics govern emerging technology competition?
ideas.description: Assess whether AI and semiconductor competition reproduces classic arms-race dynamics or follows a distinct logic.

ideas.title: Can multilateral institutions adapt to multipolarity?
ideas.description: Examine reform pathways for institutions designed under a different distribution of power.

ideas.title: How durable are the borders inherited from imperial dissolution?
ideas.description: Trace the relationship between colonial-era administrative boundaries and contemporary conflict.

ideas.title: Does industrialisation reliably produce a specific class structure?
ideas.description: Compare trajectories of class formation across industrialising regions with different institutional starting points.

ideas.title: How fast can selection act in fragmented habitats?
ideas.description: Quantify adaptive response rates under habitat fragmentation and reduced gene flow.

ideas.title: Does microbiome composition causally affect metabolic outcomes?
ideas.description: Separate causal effects from correlation using intervention designs.

ideas.title: Is the explanatory gap a permanent limit or a temporary one?
ideas.description: Assess whether the gap between physical description and subjective experience is principled or contingent on current methods.

ideas.title: Should distributive institutions track desert or need?
ideas.description: Evaluate competing justifications for distributive rules under conditions of partial compliance.

ideas.title: How should liability be allocated when general-purpose models cause harm?
ideas.description: Compare liability regimes for diffuse, multi-party AI harms.

ideas.title: Do scaling laws predict capability, or only compute?
ideas.description: Test the extrapolative validity of scaling relationships for out-of-distribution capabilities.

ideas.title: How much of mobility is explained by place?
ideas.description: Decompose intergenerational mobility into individual, household and local labour-market components.

ideas.title: Why does antimicrobial resistance resist collective action?
ideas.description: Identify the incentive structures that make stewardship collectively rational but individually costly.

ideas.title: Are climate tipping points identifiable before they are crossed?
ideas.description: Evaluate early-warning signals and their reliability for proposed tipping elements.
